svg.aria-label: Map of the Crop Analytics Orchestra: 19 members in six sections around the connector, conductoR, which runs the analysis plan. Ten arrows show which package's result another package read in one barley nitrogen study.

g.aria-label: The shared result format: the one structure every member writes and reads.
conductoR: Runs an analysis plan: a list of steps, each done by one package of the orchestra, in order.
masque: Makes a masked copy of a data table, so an analysis plan can be written and tested before the real data are used.
terroir: Supplies climate, soil and satellite series for any field location.
DataHub: Holds open datasets for testing analyses, each with its source and licence, and finds the datasets that can answer a given question.
apsimR: Runs the APSIM Next Generation crop simulator from R and returns its results in the shared format.
PESTO: Fits a crop simulator to field observations and reports the remaining uncertainty as a set of plausible simulator runs.
kernR: Tests whether field observations agree with what the crop model predicts for each treatment.
cdzoo: Recovers the likely causal structure among field variables, which decides what an analysis must adjust for.
bacipair: Estimates the effect of a change at treated sites by comparing each with a matched control site, before and after.
gpfield: Predicts a field variable over whole paddocks or regions from measurements taken at points.
kalmix: Tracks a system over time, finds the points where its behaviour changes, and estimates causal effects from a single long series.
proxymix: Replaces a complicated probability distribution with a small mixture of bell-shaped curves that is fast to compute with.
optimix: Solves optimisation problems through one description of the problem and a choice of established solvers.
survkit: Analyses time-to-event data through one interface.
koine: Builds one independent fourth opinion for a Bayesian model from a battery of inference methods, beside the opinions of the main engines.
quorum: Combines several independent estimates of the same quantity into one verdict, or reports that they do not agree enough to act on.
janusplot: Shows how each pair of continuous variables is related, as a matrix of smoothed curves, and names the shape of each curve.
flexyBayes: Fits Bayesian mixed models for multi-environment trials through several engines behind one interface.
decideR: Finds the best action under uncertainty and what more information would be worth.
grainPlan: Turns an analysis into a grower's plan: nitrogen rate, variety choice and grade target.
